payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over k, checks parity of 1-bit counts modulo k for divisors of n, uses gcd to propagate results; no exploration of x space.
payload.rationale: Solution uses direct mathematical condition, not backtracking nor bitmask enumeration. Chosen subtype is rule default but does not fit; all candidate subtypes are from complete_search but actual algorithm is a linear parity check.
